failure_split_definitions.ambiguity_among_train_solving_candidates: multiple high-train-fit candidates compete and test correctness differs
failure_split_definitions.generator_recall_failure: gold candidate absent from natural pool
failure_split_definitions.representation_failure: variant cannot overfit or ablation/control diagnostics show no useful evidence use
failure_split_definitions.train_fit_false_positive: execution/train-fit heuristic ranks a wrong candidate above gold
failure_split_definitions.verifier_ranking_failure: gold present but trainable verifier does not rank it top1

central_hypothesis: execute/test candidates on visible train pairs
use shared-weight latent clone coordination to rank/refine candidates

summary.allowed_claim_if_gates_pass: On controlled ARC-AGI-2 candidate/refinement pools, shared-weight latent clone coordination improves candidate verification/ranking over exact frozen, candidate-only, metadata-only, and heuristic baselines while passing leakage, mismatch, shuffle, and invariance controls.
